brief:
Five Palestinians were shot and wounded by Israeli settlers in the village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta near Jericho in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian Red Crescent said. The incident occurred in an area where settler violence against Palestinians has been documented repeatedly.

No further details about the circumstances of the shooting or the condition of the wounded were immediately available.
dek: Israeli settlers shoot, wound five Palestinians near Jericho, Red Crescent says Five Palestinians were shot and wounded by Israeli settlers in the village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta near Jericho in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian Red Crescent said.
title: Israeli settlers wound five Palestinians near Jericho
